summary: Iteration 6 regression — Music-box synth voice fix (bug a), AUTO-STAGGER chord-fix (bug b), pin-radius slider, and half-A/half-B STL downloads. ALL 4 features pass. GET /api/conversions/{id}/stl?part=half-a|half-b on two-sided → 200 model/stl (>100 KB); on single-sided → 404; unknown part falls back to full; GET /api/conversions/{id} echoes pin_radius; POST /api/press with pin_radius 0.1 or 1.5 → 422; press(two_sided, pin_radius=0.5) → pack zip contains {name}-halfA.stl / -halfB.stl.
